:::{#about}

Tran Cong Long is a co-founder, working and participating as the **director of science** for the laboratory. With his specialties as in **mathematical physics**, theoretical physics, an informal avid scholar in *linguistic* and ample knowledge and research incentives on both *foundational mathematics* and *foundational physics*, he is an important member and director, managing activities in `RHINELAB@MAPR` of the Mathematics and Physics Research Group/Laboratory. He is affiliated on enrolment in Vietnam National University, Hanoi University of Science (HUS, Vietnam).
